column1: # CLOSING IS RECURSIVE, AND A TYPE IS A CLOSED DEFINITION.
# `close(x)` closes every map and list beneath x; `open(x)` opens them
# and holds them open against a close from above. A closed map with a
# spread is an exhaustive set of keys sharing a shape; a closed list with
# a spread admits elements, since the spread declares every element. A copy of a type() taken by reference is an
